variants.exact: HF transformers 5.16.1 Qwen4ExpForConditionalGeneration (models/qwen38/reference.py) in F32 on the GPU runner (tools/refrun), FP8 weights times their scales exactly (dequant exact): the gate variant
variants.bf16: HF transformers 5.16.1 Qwen4ExpForConditionalGeneration (models/qwen38/reference.py) in BF16, weights dequantized and rounded to BF16 as HF loads them (dequant hf-bf16), F32 log-softmax: spread variant
variants.f64: HF transformers 5.16.1 Qwen4ExpForConditionalGeneration (models/qwen38/reference.py) in f64 with HF's own F32 steps (each run's layout.upstream_f32), dequant exact: spread variant

provenance.positions: entry i scores the token at score_from + i from the logits of the row before it; top1 is the highest logit (ties to the lower ID), margin its logit minus the second's, and the top-k columns are ranked by logit
